page.overview:
Who is Alien Commander?

The Alien Commander, named Commander Hypaxxus-8 or Commander Z, is an Alien Conquest minifigure introduced in 2011.

The Alien Commander has a red cape and his brain is visible. He has the same shape of head as the Alien Cyborg, and the same shape of legs as the Squid Warrior, except that they are reversed. The left eye has a long streak across it; probably resembling a scar or a mark. He also has golden epaulettes, as seen on soldiers from the Pirates theme, and his head is made up of three parts.

In LEGO Minifigures Online, Commander Z has regular black legs.

The Alien Commander is the main antagonist who leads the alien conquest of Earth. He pilots the Alien Mothership and has a pet Alien Clinger that is named Captain Ploovie.
